buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Generic Scope of supply includes Training: Number of employees to be trained 8 , Place for Training at igcar kapakkam. and Duration of training 2 days. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG

Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DCA MRAU payable at AT CHENNAI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of DCA MRAU payable at AT CHENNAI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Our File Ref No: DPS/MRPU/1/2/24124 1. Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Supply, installation commissioning ,training and Warranty of ALTAIR ENTERPRISE BUNDLE-PAID UP (2 USERS) : AU-ENT-STD-PDUP as technical specification annexure attached 2. Terms and Conditions: a. Installation & Commissioning: The supplier should install and commission the software at IGCAR. b. Software compatibility: The software shall be compatible for 64 bit Windows OS (10 & above). c. Documentation: Complete set of soft-copy and hard copy of manuals and documentation associated w ith the software should be supplied along with the software. d. Technical support during warranty period: Supplier must arrange 2 sessions of advance technical s upport in form of workshop during the warranty period of one year. The workshop would be splitted into 2 terms during the warranty period, i.e. 4 + 4 days [Advance + Specialized] at IGCAR. The workshop session s shall be offered by technical and subject expert team. e. License: Training trial licenses shall be provided for a period of 2 months for 3 users starting from the d ate of training. f. Warranty: On – site warranty should be for the period of one year from the date of installation. All gene ral and maintenance releases and upgrades of the software during this warranty period shall be supplied a t free of cost. Free technical support for the software should be provided during this warranty period. g. Access to the customer portal: Access to customer portal and learning hub should be provided to IG CAR, with appropriate credentials, valid during the warranty period. h. Acceptance Criteria: Successful installation, satisfactory training on the usage and effective functioni ng of all the modules and functionalities of the software at IGCAR.

3. License & Hardware failure: In case of License Server hardware failure, the supplier shall provide lice nse replacement with no extra cost on new hardware platform provided by the IGCAR. 4. Suppliers should upload document duly filled, signed and stamped regarding Self declaration with reg ards to Local content and also ensure that Local content percentage and location of value addition are clea rly mentioned, strictly as per the format of Annexure XI attached in ATC document, otherwise offer will b e rejected. 5. Only Original Equiment manufacturers of make M/s ALTAIR ENGINEERING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED or their authorized distributors should quote. If the offer is from authorized distributor the same shall be su pported with a valid letter of authorization from the respective manufacturer without which the offer will b e rejected. No other make is acceptable. 6. Bank Guarantee shall be from SBI or any nationalized bank except Gramin/Cooperative Bank. 7. Post supply inspection is not allowed. Any offer containing the conditions of post supply ins pection will be summarily rejected. 8. All the other terms & conditions as per the 'buyer added bid specific ATC document' attache d shall be adhered to. . 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
